query:
INSERT INTO snapshots (snapshot_id, generated_at, state_hash, version, data)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
        ON CONFLICT (snapshot_id) DO UPDATE SET
            generated_at = EXCLUDED.generated_at,
            state_hash = EXCLUDED.state_hash,
            version = EXCLUDED.version,
            data = EXCLUDED.data
